Assignment Title: SMART LOGISTICS ROUTE OPTIMIZER

Assignment Question:
Problem Statement

A logistics company wants to analyse the efficiency of its delivery trucks by maintaining details of every truck in its fleet. Each truck record contains the Truck ID, Driver Name, Distance Travelled (in km), and Fuel Consumed (in litres). Develop a Java program that models each truck using a Truck class with private instance variables and public getter methods. The class must demonstrate a parameterized constructor to initialize all truck details.

The program should calculate the mileage of each truck using the formula:

Mileage = Distance Travelled / Fuel Consumed

Based on the calculated mileage, classify the truck's performance according to the following criteria:

Mileage | Performance
Mileage ≥ 18 | Excellent
15 ≤ Mileage < 18 | Good
10 ≤ Mileage < 15 | Average
Mileage < 10 | Poor

The program should store all Truck objects in an array. After processing all the trucks, determine and display the details of a specific truck with the highest mileage, calculate and display the average mileage of all trucks, and display the count of trucks belonging to each performance category (Excellent, Good, Average, and Poor).

Input Format

An integer n, representing the number of trucks.

For each truck:

Truck ID

Driver Name

Distance Travelled

Fuel Consumed

Output Format

Highest Mileage Truck

<Truck ID>

<Driver Name>

< Mileage xx.xx >

<Performance Category>

<Average Mileage xx.xx>

<Number of Excellent Trucks>

<Number of Good Trucks>

<Number of Average Trucks>

<Number of Poor Trucks>

Sample Input and Output

Input | Output

Assignment Title: SMART LOGISTICS ROUTE OPTIMIZER

Assignment Question:
Problem Statement

A logistics company wants to analyse the efficiency of its delivery trucks by maintaining details of every truck in its fleet. Each truck record contains the Truck ID, Driver Name, Distance Travelled (in km), and Fuel Consumed (in litres). Develop a Java program that models each truck using a Truck class with private instance variables and public getter methods. The class must demonstrate a parameterized constructor to initialize all truck details.

The program should calculate the mileage of each truck using the formula:

Mileage = Distance Travelled / Fuel Consumed

Based on the calculated mileage, classify the truck's performance according to the following criteria:

Mileage | Performance
Mileage ≥ 18 | Excellent
15 ≤ Mileage < 18 | Good
10 ≤ Mileage < 15 | Average
Mileage < 10 | Poor

The program should store all Truck objects in an array. After processing all the trucks, determine and display the details of a specific truck with the highest mileage, calculate and display the average mileage of all trucks, and display the count of trucks belonging to each performance category (Excellent, Good, Average, and Poor).

Input Format

An integer n, representing the number of trucks.

For each truck:

Truck ID

Driver Name

Distance Travelled

Fuel Consumed

Output Format

Highest Mileage Truck

<Truck ID>

<Driver Name>

< Mileage xx.xx >

<Performance Category>

<Average Mileage xx.xx>

<Number of Excellent Trucks>

<Number of Good Trucks>

<Number of Average Trucks>

<Number of Poor Trucks>

Sample Input and Output

Input | Output
